scope: Actual isolated MFC Properties dialog inspected through Windows AccessibleObjectFromWindow. No personal catalog or browser opened.

checks.name: Properties exposes destination, address, description, Referer, login and password
Incomplete file cannot be opened
Inactive destination can be browsed
Password is masked by default
Closing Properties without OK preserves the entire record
Requested properties-dialog action is enabled
OK saves description
OK saves Referer
OK saves protected basic authentication
Another row is selected before completed-file double-click
Completed download is visible before double-click
Completed-file double-click opens the clicked record's Properties
Complete file can be opened
Complete file exposes Move
Complete destination is read-only until Move
Properties reopens with saved description
Source-page control is the native Static hyperlink implementation
Source-page Static link accepts keyboard focus
Enter activates the source-page link once
Held Enter does not repeatedly activate the link
Enter release does not activate twice
Space activates the source-page link
Disabled source-page link ignores keyboard activation
Native Static mouse notification activates the source-page link once
Load Windows accessibility provider for Properties
Windows provides link accessibility inspection
Source link exposes accessibility object
Source page is exposed as an accessible link
Main-window double-click notification is handled
